text: Society is moving from a centralized infrastructure to a decentralized, unmediated, and interconnected one, and from vertical hierarchies to horizontal, open, and autonomous networks; this transition, not the short-term versus long-term debate, is the relevant frame for corporate governance.
citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P. M. Vermeulen, The ‘Unmediated’ and ‘Tech-Driven’ Corporate Governance of Today's Winning Companies (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2922176

isBasedOn.name: The ‘Unmediated’ and ‘Tech-Driven’ Corporate Governance of Today's Winning Companies

abstract: Society is transitioning from a centralized infrastructure to a decentralized, unmediated, and interconnected infrastructure, from a world of vertical hierarchies to a world of horizontal, open, and autonomous networks.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: driven and accelerated by rapid technological change
